profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Expertise in building and successfully delivering scalable web apps using Go, .NET, React, and Typescript on Azure and AWS
profile.summary:
As a Full-Stack Developer with over 8 years of experience in the software industry, I have developed and delivered web applications that are robust, user-friendly, and secure. I have expertise in using C#/.NET, React, and Azure to create solutions that meet the needs and expectations of clients and users.

In my previous role as a Senior Consultant at Avanade, I worked with multiple teams and clients across various domains and industries, providing technical guidance, code reviews, and best practices. I also obtained certifications in Azure Fundamentals, Azure Developer Associate, and SAFe Practitioner, demonstrating my commitment to continuous learning and professional development. I am passionate about building web apps that are scalable, reliable, and efficient. I am looking for a new opportunity to apply my skills and knowledge in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and quality.
